newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait to repay $600mln in export finance on time.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait to repay $600mln in export finance on time.

text.p: Kuwait will complete payment of $600 million in export finance on time, clearing all of its foreign debts, Ali al-Badr, head of the Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA), said on Tuesday.
He told Reuters the export finance deals will be paid over the next couple of years.

He said Kuwait took a $5.5 billion sovereign loan and export finance credits of $1.2 billion mainly from the United States, Western Europe and Japan to finance reconstruction and infrastructure projects after the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation.
The jumbo loan was paid in full and on time in December 1996, wiping out all outstanding long-term foreign debts.
Kuwait's Central Bank Governor Sheikh Salem Abdul-Aziz al- Sabah has said his country, once one of the world's largest investors, would not borrow from international markets again.
